fixedFramework: The primary delivery is a responsive renovation-booklet Page covering the project summary, evidence, analysis, design narrative, plan, renders, materials and budget scope, consistency matrix, confirmation history, exclusions, and site-verification list.

Complex interactive 3D is a separate same-revision Page linked from the booklet and opened in a new browser page; only that specialist Page uses the su-design-classic mobile-landscape canvas, and it stays a focused model viewer without requirements or booklet narrative.
The user-uploaded source plan, Agent annotation, governed project, Pascal scene model basis, and Page payload must resolve to the same evidence hash.
The Pascal scene remains the only production 3D engine and supplies the model-derived SVG failure fallback.
A dedicated loading state precedes automatic first-frame 3D warmup; Canvas visibility must not depend on a click or drag.
Perspective and orthographic views, stacked and isolated levels, labels, highlights, concept comparison, requirements, audit findings, and revision history remain available.
The governed concept render records image, reference and prompt hashes, stays explicitly conceptual, and cannot replace construction drawings or material samples.
The delivery carries no remote resources, no customer data, and no claim of survey, construction drawing, structural, engineering, or code-compliance authority.

The Agent supplies governed project data only. The render-interior-pages capability owns HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive behavior, 3D interaction, manifests, diagnostics, and compatible renderer upgrades.
agentFreedom: Derive spatial strategy and annotations from the current governed project evidence.
Choose room, wall, opening, furniture, cabinet, material-intent, lighting-intent, and label content within the accepted project scope.
Revise the governed scene and regenerate a new immutable delivery after user feedback.
